name: Lateral ankle sprain
note: Avoid plyometric loading until ankle function and hop performance support a safe return.

citation.reference: Martin RL, Davenport TE, Fraser JJ, et al. Ankle Stability and Movement Coordination Impairments: Lateral Ankle Ligament Sprains Revision 2021. J Orthop Sports Phys Ther. 2021;51(4):CPG1-CPG80.

name: Nonspecific low back pain
note: Use symptom-guided loading for exercises that load the lumbar spine.

citation.reference: George SZ, Fritz JM, Silfies SP, et al. Interventions for the Management of Acute and Chronic Low Back Pain: Revision 2021. J Orthop Sports Phys Ther. 2021;51(11):CPG1-CPG60.

name: Patellofemoral pain syndrome
note: Reduce squat depth or load when knee flexion provokes patellofemoral pain.

citation.reference: Willy RW, Hoglund LT, Barton CJ, et al. Patellofemoral Pain: Clinical Practice Guidelines. J Orthop Sports Phys Ther. 2019;49(9):CPG1-CPG95.

name: Shoulder impingement
note: Modify overhead pressing to stay within tolerated load and range.

citation.reference: Desmeules F, Roy JS, Lafrance S, et al. Rotator Cuff Tendinopathy Diagnosis, Nonsurgical Medical Care, and Rehabilitation: A Clinical Practice Guideline. J Orthop Sports Phys Ther. 2025;55(4):235-274.
